deadline.what: The date by which the client must send the document. Set when assigning the form; optional.

expiration.what: How long the uploaded document stays valid. “No expiry” means the document never expires.
expiration.example: e.g. A passport expires on 3 March 2028.

daysAfterUpload.what: Expiry is calculated automatically: upload date + this many days.
daysAfterUpload.example: e.g. 365 → the document expires one year after upload.

startDays.what: How many days before the deadline reminders begin. Ignored if the assignment has no deadline.
startDays.example: e.g. 7 → the first reminder is sent 7 days before the deadline.

repeatEvery.what: How often a new reminder is sent until the client submits the document.
repeatEvery.example: e.g. 3 days → one reminder every 3 days.

unit.what: The unit of the interval: hours, days or weeks.
unit.example: Hours count from the moment of assignment: the first reminder after N hours, then every N hours, outside quiet hours.

sendTime.what: The time of day the reminder is sent (organization time zone).
sendTime.example: Not needed when the interval is in hours.

afterDeadline.what: Keeps reminding after the deadline passes if the client still hasn't submitted.
afterDeadline.example: e.g. every week, up to 4 times.

overdueEvery.what: How often a reminder is sent once the deadline has passed.
overdueEvery.example: e.g. 1 week → one reminder per week.

maxReminders.what: How many reminders are sent after the deadline. Empty: use defaults, 0: no limit.

weekday.what: The day of the week the reminder is sent.
weekday.example: e.g. Monday → reminders go out on Mondays only, at the send time.
